leads.summary: PR #13138's independent bar parser conflicts with this PR's all-numeric-keys parser; combining either branch verbatim breaks the other feature or its test
leads.consequence: If a merge keeps #13138's whitelist, icon-slot/icon-canvas/icon-font/status-slot are again dropped and #13137's six-key test fails. If it keeps #13137's catch-all instead, [bar] margin = "4 8" is truncated by parseInt to 4, so the separately promised per-edge margins become uniform, and #13138's test requiring barOut[key] = raw fails. A combined parser must special-case margin unchanged and pass all remaining numeric keys; reconcile both bar-test.sh changes.

leads.summary: New icon-slot and status-slot documentation says width, but vertical bars consume them as height
leads.consequence: A vertical-bar user following the new comments expects changing these keys to widen widgets, but they set the height along the bar (and do not change the cross-axis width). State that these are along-bar extents: width horizontally, height vertically.

leads.summary: The new VM regression test bypasses the actual six Style.bar properties and masks a broken scaling path
leads.consequence: A regression wiring iconSlot to the wrong barToken key, or removing fontScale multiplication from barToken, still passes the six new assertions, while the visible icon size is wrong or no longer scales at nondefault font sizes. For coverage of those contracts, exercise actual property key/fallback mappings and run a non-1 fontScale case (or scope the assertion description to parser-to-helper only). This does not dispute that the positive six-key parser test now catches the original omitted keys.

## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

Follow-up to the [earlier review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/13137#issuecomment-5824278860) and the [author's reply](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/13137#issuecomment-5829004869), checked at head `ab3fa9e`. Both earlier points are resolved. No new defects were found.

| Earlier point | Status at `ab3fa9e` |
|---|---|
| Added test matched source text, not parser behavior | Resolved |
| Four newly effective keys undocumented | Resolved (one wording note below) |

**Verified (test):** `test/shell.d/bar-test.sh` now extracts `barToken`, `boolToken` and `applyShellValues` from `Style.qml` into a `vm` context, applies all six `bar.*` keys and checks each `barToken()` result. On the base `Style.qml` it fails at `icon-slot` (expected 30, actual 1), and `test/shell` reports the file as failed. The full file passes on the head. Diagnostic `Style.qml` variants:

| `Style.qml` variant | Real regression? | New test | Earlier text-matching test |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base parser (size keys only) | yes | fail | fail |
| Allowlist of `size-vertical` only | yes | fail | pass |
| Five-key allowlist without `icon-font` | yes | fail at `icon-font` | fail |
| `barToken()` ignores overrides | yes | fail | pass |
| `barOverrides = barOut` removed | yes | fail | pass |
| Explicit six-key allowlist, `const b`, `parseFloat` | no | pass | fail |

The test fixes `fontScale` at 1 and calls `barToken()` directly, so `base-size` scaling, `scale-with-font` parsing and the `Style.bar` property wiring are not covered. None of these paths is changed by this PR.

**Verified (docs):** The four keys are now in the "Bar size" block of `docs/omarchy-shell.md`, the `[bar]` comments of `default/themed/shell.toml.tpl` and the `Style.qml` header. The documented defaults 27/16/13/21 match the `barToken()` fallbacks, and the scaling statements match `barToken()`. Uncommenting the new template lines parses correctly and leaves every token at its default.

**Verified (production):** Since the earlier reviewed head `d6fa34d`, the commit changes only comments, docs and the test. The parser behavior from the earlier review still holds: the four keys reach `Style.bar.*` (34/22/24/26, or 51/33/36/39 at `base-size` 18), user values win over theme values, invalid values fall back, and configs without these keys give the same tokens as the base.

**Optional documentation note:** "width of one widget slot" (`icon-slot`) and "width of a status indicator slot" (`status-slot`) hold only for top/bottom bars. On left/right bars, icon buttons and status indicators use these values as the slot's height (`shell/Ui/BarIconButton.qml:20-21`, `shell/Ui/BarIndicator.qml:49-50`). The earlier review's "slot width" wording contributed to this. Wording such as "length of one icon slot along the bar" would fit both orientations. Also, `icon-font` does not reach status indicators, which use `Style.font.caption` (`shell/Ui/BarIndicator.qml:46`); the PR description already leaves glyph sizing out of scope.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source review of head `ab3fa9e` against the earlier reviewed head `d6fa34d` and the merge-base `28ceaae`. `bar-test.sh` ran in an isolated sandbox under Node on the head, and the head test also ran against the base and earlier-head `Style.qml` and 13 diagnostic variants. The earlier review's token scenarios, other than the reload after removing the keys, were rerun with the real `shell.toml` parsing and merging functions and the `Style.qml` token functions under Node, with `fontScale` modeled from `base-size`. Not exercised: Quickshell's QML engine, the full test suite and live bar rendering.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, Opus 5.5 Xhigh technical review and final fact check, GPT 6 Sol Xhigh search for related issues, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
